articles.summary: The New England Patriots are enjoying a strong run, and Andy Borregales is playing his part in the team's success. Following a 45-17 win over the Las Vegas Raiders, the Venezuelan kicker spoke with Nacho García for MARCA about the team's confidence, his admiration for Adam, and a projection that caught him by surprise: if he maintains his pace for 23 seasons, he could surpass the NFL's all-time scoring record. “I didn't know that. Well, that's the plan,” he replied, making it clear that, for now, he'd rather focus on each kick and helping New England keep winning. During the interview, he also opened up about the upcoming arrival of his son and discussed the growing Latino presence in the league.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes’ son Bronze steals the spotlight with adorable Taylor Swift moment
articles.summary: A video has surfaced showing the moment Patrick Mahomes signed his contract extension with the Kansas City Chiefs, but it was his son Bronze who stole the spotlight. As the quarterback celebrated a major milestone in his career with his family by his side, Bronze was walking through the halls of Arrowhead Stadium when he spotted a photo of Taylor Swift from her Eras Tour stop in Kansas City and excitedly said, “It’s Taylor!” Fans melted over the little boy’s reaction, with some pointing out how familiar Swift has become to the Mahomes children. One fan drew a comparison to Jason and Travis Kelce’s story about how the Kelce girls initially called her “Taylor Swift” before eventually knowing her simply as Taylor or “Aunt Tay,” adding that Bronze’s reaction showed just how comfortable he is around the singer.
